note: A `for generate` whose index advances by two, folding a byte into the parity of each adjacent pair of bits. End-to-end cover for hif-core#24, fixed by hif-core 5603a2a: expansion substituted the iteration ordinal for the genvar, so a loop over 0, 2, 4, 6 elaborated over 0, 1, 2, 3 - every iteration reading its neighbour's pair, two output lanes left with no driver and two with two - at exit 0, with no diagnostic and valid Verilog out. The corpus had no strided generate at all when that fix landed, which is why it measured a byte-identical corpus: nothing here reached the defect. hif-core's own tests own the exhaustive loop-header matrix; this design asks only that ordinary HDL reaches the corrected semantics through the real toolchain, by simulation. Behavioural because the structural pipeline cannot see it - the regenerated design reparses cleanly whichever iterations it was given. Filed under parameterized/ with the other generate designs, since the question is elaboration rather than the logic. See also for_generate_descending, which covers the `op_gt` half of the same defect and which a stride cannot reach.
